findings.rootCause: Completion claims had no evidence-backed manifest.
findings.fix: Added two revision-pinned claim records with implementation and execution evidence.

findings.rootCause: The policy required audit evidence but no scoped audit policy existed.
findings.fix: Added a scope-limited local audit policy and linked evidence without making a production compliance claim.

findings.rootCause: A hard-coded secret-like value was emitted under an authorization log label.
findings.fix: Removed hard-coded secret-like value and all sensitive logging; added validated request handling with no secret configuration path in the local fixture.
findings.regressionEvidence: final assurance-gate report shows no SENSITIVE-LOGGING finding

findings.rootCause: A test double asserted an artificial successful payment response rather than service behavior.
findings.fix: Replaced mocked test with Node-native real filesystem integration tests for retry, conflict, validation, and concurrency.
findings.regressionEvidence: node --test tests/payment-service.test.js and final assurance-gate report

findings.rootCause: The mocked behavior and assertion supplied no real durable operation evidence.
findings.fix: Removed the mocked assertion and added a true duplicate-operation count assertion against a temporary filesystem store.
findings.regressionEvidence: node --test tests/payment-service.test.js and final assurance-gate report
